name: Ramin
source:
An egoistical pink and gray cockatoo, the ''elder brother'' of the group. He likes being needed and taking care of others, acting as a guardian to the main character and other pets. He can be pushy sometimes, but he also prioritizes the happiness of the main character.

From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/447180/My_Secret_Pets/?curator_clanid=33519001]Steam[/url]
